$comment: The released janus-engine the SDKs resolve when they are not building one from this tree (staged plan S0.4 and S0.10, X.1; ADR 0029 decision 3): a version, and the SHA-256 of the engine binary for each target triple, keyed by the release's asset name. The digests are copied from that release's SHA256SUMS after `gh attestation verify` has passed on it, and a resolver refuses any download whose digest is not here. `version` is null until there is a first release to pin.
